steps.step: deploy table, Lambda (python3.12) and REST v1 {proxy+} stand-in
enroll company key (admin, signed challenge)
authorized register
denied: no token
denied: wrong org (key enrolled in orgA, token orgB)
duplicate retry returns the original ack
lost ack: retry after a discarded response
withdrawal: share 200, withdrawn, then 404 (also after an identical register retry)
deletion: registration tombstoned, its share 404
steps.detail: DELETE 200, GET share 404, stored state deleted

steps.step: replay after deletion (new idempotency key)
replay after dedupe expiry (8s)
list registrations, one per page with a cursor (DynamoDB Query)
list keys
pilot key enroll (pilot challenge + company-key authorization)
pilot key register
pilot key retire (admin)
pilot key register after retire refused
list keys shows the pilot key retired
epoch bump (transaction with its tombstone) invalidates an outstanding envelope
restore gate: public and authenticated routes 503 restore_pending before tombstones are applied
restore apply (Scan, Put, Update in DynamoDB): withdrawn and deleted views 404, active one 200
steps.detail: 6 tombstones applied; live/withdrawn/deleted share GET: [200, 404, 404]; backup emulated by copying items and undoing the withdrawal and deletion (no PITR in LocalStack community)

steps.step: persistence: share served before restart
persistence after docker restart (same container, volume, PERSISTENCE=1)
persistence after docker rm and re-create on the same volume
teardown: container and volume removed
